name: QuickBooks Online
best_for: Most common choice for US small businesses
notes: List price; first 3 months are half off. Intuit's pages disagree on Essentials and Plus prices. Payroll is a paid add-on. Simple Start is 1 user plus 2 accountants.

name: Xero
usage_note: Early $27, Growing $59, Established $97; first 3 months discounted
best_for: Unlimited users on a flat price
notes: US figures come from a search snippet of Xero's US page that may be about 9 months old; Xero raised prices elsewhere in Nov 2025. Recheck before relying on it.

name: Digits
since_note: Company founded 2018; public launch March 2025 (press coverage).
best_for: AI-run books with no per-user fee
notes: Not stated: digits.com pricing could not be read. Review sites list $65 to $250 a month, but that is unconfirmed.

name: Ramp
free_plan_limits: Free plan includes invoice capture, bill pay and ERP connections
usage_note: Ramp Plus $15 per user per month plus a platform fee
notes: Spend and bill-pay tool, not a full ledger; it syncs to accounting software. Prices from Ramp blog posts; pricing page blocked. Some ERP links need Plus.

name: Zoho Books
usage_note: Per organization; Standard $15 billed yearly; Professional $50 monthly
notes: Standard allows 3 users, Professional 5. Free-plan limits come from an older comparison document. Payroll is a separate Zoho product.

name: Wave
free_plan_limits: Unlimited invoices, bills, estimates and bookkeeping records
usage_note: Pro $19 monthly or $190 yearly; payroll $15/mo plus $4 per employee
since_note: Wave Accounting launched July 2009; opened to the public November 2010 (Wikipedia).
notes: Pro adds bank auto-import and receipt capture. Payroll is a separate paid add-on. Payment fees apply to card payments (not read).
